title: TikTok paid advertising: documented format specifications
scope: Auction In-Feed (Non-Spark), Spark Ads, reservation In-Feed incl. R&F, TopView, Carousel, TikTok Ad Network (Pangle), Global App Bundle video and image. Public official documentation only; not account-tested.

technical_requirements.audio: Must not be silent; no harsh sounds esp. first 3 s; not pure verbal broadcast; promo sentence max twice in a row
technical_requirements.first_3_seconds: No plain white; vertical; nothing overlapping TikTok logo, skip button or swipe-up link
technical_requirements.content: Real people or narrative animation; still pictures not main narrative; no fake UI; no QR/barcodes/phone/address except required disclaimers
technical_requirements.url: HTTPS web view or TikTok in-app URL; no app store links; no external deeplinks
technical_requirements.exclusivity: Same creative not in other placements same day, nor day before/after 100% SOV TopView; pre-approval; max 20 ads per ad group

records.safe_zone: Two-stage templates (open screen first 3 s; in-feed, stricter), LTR and RTL, zip download. Not transcribed.
records.notes: Qualified customers only. Default delivery to TikTok Lite in Japan and Korea for ad groups created from October 2025. Source: https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/about-topview
